observation: One earlier debugging run (lens-start-before, first attempt, source variant before the add-to-note repair) failed e2e/live-lens.spec.ts:67 with the root not-found page; the identical rerun passed.
whatProducesThatPage: src/app/patients/[patientId]/layout.tsx calls notFound() only when api.patients.get returns no row; a failed read throws to the error boundary instead (patients.live.ts get; clinicalSelect throws on HTTP errors).

The fixture backend answers patient_profiles with [] when the bearer's memberships are revoked, the bearer carries --noorg or outsider, or the clinic is not the bearer's (scripts/live-stub-server.mjs memberOrgIdsForBearer and the patient_profiles handler).
Every fixture session shares one bearer, fixture-access-token; live-inbox, live-programs, live-sync and live-tasks revoke and later restore it through /__control/revoke-memberships.
instrumentation: A debugging-only fetch preload in the dev server recorded every patient_profiles read (time, pid, clinic, row count, bearer digest, never the token) and every fixture sign-in; the dev server log was kept for restart lines.
coldRunsResult: 6 of 6 cold runs (fresh fixture backend and fresh next dev each) passed 9 of 9; 66 patient reads, 0 empty, one bearer digest, one clinic, one server pid per run, no restart lines. Not reproduced.

deterministicProducerOfTheSymptom.method: Fresh backend and dev server; GET the lens encounter page; revoke the shared fixture bearer through the backend's own control; GET again; reset; GET again.
deterministicProducerOfTheSymptom.result: control 200 with the patient breadcrumb; revoked 404 (root not-found page, no breadcrumb), patient read 0 rows; after reset 200. The symptom follows a revoked shared bearer deterministically.

whyThisIsNotTheDiagnosis: The original run started its own fresh backend and ran only live-lens.spec.ts, which never revokes; a process check right after it found no other backend, dev server or Playwright process. Nothing places a revocation or a second client on that run's backend, so the mechanism is a candidate, not a cause.
status: unresolved: observed once, not reproduced in 6 cold runs, one deterministic producer of the identical page identified but not shown to have occurred. No timeout raised, no retry added, nothing changed in source.
limitations: Local next dev and the in-memory fixture backend only; not CI, not hosted.
